# Agent Python Tools

- repo: berriai/litellm
- repo_uri: https://github.com/berriai/litellm

## File: berriai_litellm/tests/litellm-proxy-extras/test_litellm_proxy_extras_utils.py

Prompts

```
['test the ProxyExtrasDBManager to detect PostgreSQL permission denied and must be owner errors', 'test the ProxyExtrasDBManager to detect already exists and duplicate key idempotent errors', 'test that permission errors are not classified as idempotent errors and vice versa', 'test the ProxyExtrasDBManager prisma directory configuration using the LITELLM_MIGRATION_DIR environment variable', 'test all migration SQL files use idempotent DDL patterns like IF NOT EXISTS and IF EXISTS']
```

Usage

```
{'test_permission_error_detection': 'test the ProxyExtrasDBManager to detect PostgreSQL permission denied and must be owner errors', 'test_idempotent_error_detection': 'test the ProxyExtrasDBManager to detect already exists and duplicate key idempotent errors', 'test_error_classification_priority': 'test that permission errors are not classified as idempotent errors and vice versa', 'test_custom_prisma_dir': 'test the ProxyExtrasDBManager prisma directory configuration using the LITELLM_MIGRATION_DIR environment variable', 'test_migration_sql_idempotency': 'test all migration SQL files use idempotent DDL patterns like IF NOT EXISTS and IF EXISTS'}
```
